name: Frog mi quang
summary: Mì Quảng with frog, the other bowl Cư M’gar and Krông Pắc are known for.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 10 Feb 2021 names mì Quảng ếch with mì Quảng gà for Cư M’gar and Krông Pắc.
howToEat: It sits beside the chicken bowl as the districts’ second mì Quảng.
seoTitle: Mi quang ech — frog mi quang in Krong Pac
seoDescription: Frog mi Quang from Cu M’gar and Krong Pac, beside the chicken bowl.
